correctness.rationale: The input operator-norm variational identity and existence of an interior maximizer for alpha>3/2 are explicitly imported from Cui–Lin–Lu–Ye Theorem 1.1. The source decomposition of P_alpha splits D into M_alpha/[2(alpha-1)]+d_alpha J_alpha-R_alpha. The transformed regular M and endpoint-rescaled R have uniform first derivatives at h=0, with coefficients K_{3/2}=pi and R_{3/2} linear coefficient pi; J_alpha~2^alpha h^(alpha-1) and d_{3/2+epsilon}~pi epsilon. Thus D(1-h)-D(1)=2^alpha d_alpha h^(alpha-1)-c_alpha h+smaller terms, c_alpha->2pi, uniformly with derivative. Strict boundary optimality at 3/2 and continuity localize every optimizer h->0. Stationarity gives h~epsilon²/2 and substitution gives pi epsilon² excess. Independently recomputed the two beta coefficients numerically/high-precision and gamma-ratio leading constant; source CHECK.py was examined. Finite tests do not establish the uniform differentiability; analytic majorants are essential.
